decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): [ev-7ed93148a767] says what changed: the project's 'live' DNS tests were moved into a separate package to contain test flakiness and improve developer UX. The release notes file it under "Other (Cleanup or Flake)". The subject is the project's own test code and the change is a reorganisation of that code. Nothing in the evidence names an operator-facing surface, so an engineer can record the subject, change and applicability as having no deployed subject and no exposure, with a consequence of none (informational).
